policy: Run every listed Test, Fuzz seed and Example once. Partition top-level functions into disjoint groups of four, sequentially. Go's original default test timeout and all test bodies are unchanged. This limits simultaneous PGlite memory and avoids the measured ten-minute whole-store timeout. Two disk-full PostgreSQL batches retried with unchanged inputs; accepted log contains only real successful disjoint invocation segments, failed raw attempts remain immutable and explicitly referenced.
